assets.what_it_shows: 15 Aug 2008, Edinburgh Zoo: Nils Olav, a badge on his right flipper, walks along a line of King's Guard soldiers holding rifles, looking up at an officer. Spectators in the background. Featured picture on en-wiki.
assets.best_segments: THE hero shot. Use it for the twist line (knighted, inspects troops). Vertical 9:16 crop at full height (1602 px wide): x of about 1450-3050 keeps the penguin plus the officer; or slowly push in from the rifle line (left) to the penguin (right). Zoom the flipper badge for the knighthood beat.

assets.license_note: Photo released to PD by the photographer. The sculpture (Oystein Bernhard Mobraten, 2005, per Forsvarets forum) is covered by UK freedom of panorama (CDPA s.62: sculpture permanently in premises open to the public).
assets.credit_line: Photo: Erik Swanson (Farmer erik), public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
assets.what_it_shows: Close-up of the bronze Nils Olav statue at Edinburgh Zoo, in front of grass and rocks; a regimental badge is cast on the right flipper.
assets.best_segments: Native portrait, so a full 9:16 crop with no loss. Slow tilt up from the flipper badge to the head; good for the closer ('Major General Sir Nils Olav').

assets.what_it_shows: 11 May 2019, Edinburgh Zoo: a king penguin identified by the photographer as Nils Olav, in profile on the rocks at Penguins Rock, with a purple band on the flipper. Sharp and high resolution. This is the current bird (III) if the ID is right.
assets.best_segments: Hook shot ('This penguin is a general...'): portrait, head at the top third, so it is 9:16-ready. Push in on the face.

assets.best_segments: A funny 'standing at attention' frame, portrait, for the 1972 'how it started' line. Crop out the visitor at the top right.

assets.best_segments: Low resolution (480x640). Use only as a small inset or a fast cut, e.g. on the ladder diagram at the '2005 Colonel-in-Chief' step.

assets.what_it_shows: 28 Apr 2018, Norfolk, Virginia: His Majesty the King's Guard Band and Drill Team drumline in full uniform (plumed hats, green epaulettes). This is the same unit that visits Nils.
assets.best_segments: Establishing shot for 'Norwegian army' / 'King's Guard'. It is landscape, so pan horizontally across the drummers in a 9:16 window. Avoid the 'Virginia International Tattoo' banner if a clean frame is needed.

assets.what_it_shows: 21 May 2014, Copenhagen tattoo: rows of young Norwegian King's Guard soldiers marching with rifles, white gloves, and the royal cap badge, in dramatic low light.
assets.best_segments: A moody 'serious army' beat just before the reveal. It is landscape, so use a centre 9:16 crop on one guardsman's face, or a slow lateral pan.

assets.what_it_shows: 30 Nov 2017, Akershus Fortress, Oslo: three King's Guard soldiers in winter greatcoats marching away through a stone archway (seen from behind).
assets.best_segments: Portrait and native 9:16. Spare b-roll for 'Norway's King's Guard'; less on-topic than the drumline and Copenhagen shots.

assets.what_it_shows: 1 Jun 2009, Edinburgh Zoo penguin parade: two king penguins in the foreground and gentoos behind, walking on paving. These are not identified as Nils.
